topics.title: 因式分解与恒等式
topics.explain: 把多项式写成较简单因子的乘积，方便求根及化简。
topics.explainEn: Express a polynomial as a product to simplify it or find roots.
topics.condition: 恒等式在实数或复数范围成立。
topics.conditionEn: Valid over real or complex numbers.
topics.application: 例如x²−9=0得到x=±3；用于尺寸关系和公式整理。
topics.applicationEn: For x²−9=0, x=±3; useful for dimension relations and formula rearrangement.

topics.title: 一元二次方程
topics.explain: 二次方程的判别式决定实根数量，配方给出求根公式。
topics.explainEn: The discriminant determines the number of real roots; completing the square gives the formula.
topics.condition: a≠0；Δ<0时无实根，但有复根。
topics.conditionEn: a≠0; a negative discriminant gives complex rather than real roots.
topics.application: 抛物线轨迹、面积约束；x²−5x+6=0的根为2和3。
topics.applicationEn: Parabolic trajectories and area constraints; x²−5x+6=0 has roots 2 and 3.

topics.title: 多项式余式与因式定理
topics.explain: 除以x−a的余式等于在a处的函数值；余式为零即存在该因式。
topics.explainEn: The remainder on division by x−a equals the value at a; a zero value identifies a factor.
topics.condition: p为域上的一元多项式。
topics.conditionEn: p is a univariate polynomial over a field.
topics.application: 快速检测候选根；p(2)=0说明x−2为因式。
topics.applicationEn: Test candidate roots quickly; p(2)=0 identifies x−2 as a factor.

topics.title: 指数与对数
topics.explain: 指数描述乘法增长，对数把乘法转成加法，两者互为逆运算。
topics.explainEn: Exponentials describe multiplicative growth; logarithms convert products to sums and invert exponentials.
topics.condition: 实对数要求a>0、a≠1、x>0、y>0。
topics.conditionEn: Real logarithms require a>0, a≠1 and positive arguments.
topics.application: 复利、衰减及增长时间；2ᵗ=8给出t=3。
topics.applicationEn: Compound interest, decay and growth time; 2ᵗ=8 gives t=3.

topics.title: 等差与等比数列
topics.explain: 等差数列相邻差固定，等比数列相邻比固定。
topics.explainEn: Arithmetic sequences have a constant difference; geometric sequences have a constant ratio.
topics.condition: n为正整数；等比求和q=1时Sₙ=na₁。
topics.conditionEn: n is a positive integer; for q=1 the geometric sum is na₁.
topics.application: 分期投入、逐月增长预算；无穷等比和在abs(q)<1时为a₁/(1−q)。
topics.applicationEn: Staged expenditure and growing budgets; the infinite geometric sum is a₁/(1−q) when abs(q)<1.

topics.title: 二项式定理
topics.explain: 给出和的整数次幂展开，系数为组合数。
topics.explainEn: Expands a nonnegative integer power of a sum using binomial coefficients.
topics.condition: n为非负整数；广义实指数展开需另外检查收敛。
topics.conditionEn: n is a nonnegative integer; generalized real powers need convergence conditions.
topics.application: 组合计数、概率计算；(a+b)³=a³+3a²b+3ab²+b³。
topics.applicationEn: Counting and probability; (a+b)³=a³+3a²b+3ab²+b³.

topics.title: 复数与欧拉公式
topics.explain: 复数把平面旋转和伸缩统一为乘法；欧拉公式连接指数与三角函数。
topics.explainEn: Complex multiplication combines rotation and scaling; Euler formula links exponentials and trigonometry.
topics.formula: z=a+bi=r(cos θ+i sin θ)=re^(iθ); e^(iθ)=cos θ+i sin θ
topics.condition: i²=−1；角度使用弧度，非零复数的辐角模2π确定。
topics.conditionEn: i²=−1; angles are in radians and nonzero arguments are defined modulo 2π.
topics.application: 交流电相量、振动；乘以i相当于逆时针旋转90°。
topics.applicationEn: AC phasors and vibrations; multiplying by i rotates by 90° counterclockwise.

topics.title: 不等式与估计
topics.explain: 不等式为误差、最值和可行范围提供边界。
topics.explainEn: Inequalities bound errors, extrema and feasible values.
topics.condition: 均值不等式要求a,b≥0；柯西不等式适用于有限实向量。
topics.conditionEn: AM–GM requires nonnegative values; Cauchy–Schwarz applies to finite real vectors.
topics.application: 固定周长矩形以正方形面积最大；估计测量误差上界。
topics.applicationEn: A square maximizes rectangle area at fixed perimeter; bound measurement errors.

topics.title: 群与同态
topics.explain: 群抽象可逆的对称操作，同态保留运算结构。
topics.explainEn: A group abstracts reversible symmetries; a homomorphism preserves its operation.
topics.formula: φ(ab)=φ(a)φ(b); ker φ={g:φ(g)=e}; G/ker φ ≅ im φ
topics.condition: 群满足结合律、单位元和逆元；商群要求正规子群。
topics.conditionEn: Associativity, identity and inverses are required; quotient groups need normal subgroups.
topics.application: 旋转对称、密码学；整数模n的加法构成群。
topics.applicationEn: Rotational symmetry and cryptography; addition modulo n forms a group.

topics.title: 环与域
topics.explain: 环把加法与乘法结合；域要求每个非零元素都有乘法逆。
topics.explainEn: Rings combine addition and multiplication; fields make every nonzero element invertible.
topics.formula: a(b+c)=ab+ac; in a field: a≠0 ⇒ a·a⁻¹=1
topics.condition: 一般环未必交换或无零因子；域必交换且无零因子。
topics.conditionEn: A general ring need not be commutative or free of zero divisors; fields are both.
topics.application: 整数是环但不是域；有理数、实数和复数是域，用于方程求解。
topics.applicationEn: Integers form a ring but not a field; rational, real and complex fields support equation solving.

topics.title: 模运算与中国剩余定理
topics.titleEn: Modular arithmetic and Chinese remainder theorem
topics.explain: 同余把整数按余数归类，互素模数的条件可合成为唯一余数类。
topics.explainEn: Congruence groups integers by residues; coprime modular constraints combine uniquely.
topics.formula: a≡b (mod m) ⇔ m divides (a−b); x≡aᵢ (mod mᵢ) has one class mod ∏mᵢ
topics.condition: 中国剩余定理此形式要求mᵢ两两互素。
topics.conditionEn: This form requires pairwise coprime positive moduli.
topics.application: 周期排班、校验码；x≡2(mod3)、x≡3(mod5)给出x≡8(mod15)。
topics.applicationEn: Periodic schedules and checksums; residues 2 modulo 3 and 3 modulo 5 give 8 modulo 15.

topics.title: 域扩张与伽罗瓦思想
topics.explain: 研究增添代数元素后得到的域，以及保持基域不变的自同构。
topics.explainEn: Studies fields obtained by adjoining algebraic elements and automorphisms fixing the base field.
topics.condition: 伽罗瓦对应要求扩张正规且可分；一般五次方程无通用根式公式。
topics.conditionEn: Galois correspondence needs a normal separable extension; a general quintic has no radical formula.
topics.application: 理解方程可解性、尺规作图；Q(√2)在Q上次数为2。
topics.applicationEn: Understand equation solvability and constructibility; Q(√2) has degree 2 over Q.

topics.title: 黄金分割与递推
topics.explain: 一段长度分为较长段a和较短段b，整体与长段之比等于长段与短段之比。
topics.explainEn: Split a length into a longer part a and a shorter part b so that whole-to-long equals long-to-short.
topics.condition: a、b为正数；这是比例性质，不代表所有设计或自然对象均服从此比率。
topics.conditionEn: a and b are positive. This ratio is not a universal law of design or nature.
topics.application: 比例构图及斐波那契递推的极限比值。
topics.applicationEn: Proportional layouts and limiting ratios of Fibonacci numbers.
stepsEn: Let r=a/b, giving r=1+1/r.
Solve r²−r−1=0; the positive root is about 1.618.

topics.title: 三角形面积与海伦公式
topics.explain: 三角形可用底高、夹角或三边计算面积。
topics.explainEn: A triangle area follows from a base and height, two sides and an included angle, or all three sides.
topics.condition: 三边为正且满足三角不等式；C为a、b夹角。
topics.conditionEn: Positive sides satisfy triangle inequalities; C is the angle between a and b.
topics.application: 地块测量；3、4、5直角三角形面积为6。
topics.applicationEn: Land surveying; a 3–4–5 triangle has area 6.

topics.title: 圆、扇形与弧长
topics.explain: 圆的长度与半径成正比，面积与半径平方成正比。
topics.explainEn: Circumference is linear in radius, while area is quadratic.
topics.condition: r≥0；θ以弧度计。
topics.conditionEn: r≥0; θ is in radians.
topics.application: 弯管长度、环形场地；半径2的半圆弧长为2π。
topics.applicationEn: Curved pipe lengths and circular sites; a semicircle of radius 2 has arc length 2π.

topics.title: 四边形与多边形面积
topics.explain: 规则图形用底高关系，任意简单多边形可用坐标计算。
topics.explainEn: Regular figures use base-height relations; coordinates handle general simple polygons.
topics.condition: 多边形顶点按边界顺序排列并首尾闭合；自交图形需另行解释。
topics.conditionEn: Vertices follow boundary order and close the polygon; self-intersections require care.
topics.application: CAD地块和房间面积计算；不依赖图形朝向。
topics.applicationEn: CAD parcel and room areas independent of orientation.

topics.title: 常见立体体积与表面积
topics.explain: 立体计算用于容量、混凝土用量及表面处理面积。
topics.explainEn: Solid geometry determines capacity, concrete quantities and surface treatment area.
topics.formula: cuboid V=abc; cylinder V=πr²h, A=2πr(r+h); sphere V=4πr³/3, A=4πr²; cone V=πr²h/3
topics.condition: 使用一致长度单位；圆柱和圆锥为直圆柱、直圆锥。
topics.conditionEn: Use consistent length units; formulas assume right circular cylinders and cones.
topics.application: 水箱容积、柱体混凝土、球罐涂装面积。
topics.applicationEn: Tank capacity, column concrete and spherical tank coatings.

topics.title: 勾股定理与距离
topics.explain: 欧氏空间中距离由各正交方向分量平方和确定。
topics.explainEn: Euclidean distance is the square root of the sum of squared orthogonal components.
topics.condition: 勾股定理要求直角；坐标须为正交笛卡尔坐标。
topics.conditionEn: The triangle must be right-angled; coordinates must be orthogonal Cartesian coordinates.
topics.application: 斜撑长度、空间测距；水平3、竖向4得到斜长5。
topics.applicationEn: Brace lengths and spatial measurement; horizontal 3 and vertical 4 give length 5.

topics.title: 相似与尺度变换
topics.explain: 相似保持形状与角度，线长、面积、体积按不同幂次缩放。
topics.explainEn: Similarity preserves shape and angles while lengths, areas and volumes scale with different powers.
topics.condition: 几何相似且k>0；材料性质不因此自动相似。
topics.conditionEn: Geometric similarity with k>0; material behavior does not automatically scale.
topics.application: 模型试验、图纸比例；尺寸放大2倍，体积放大8倍。
topics.applicationEn: Scale models and drawings; doubling dimensions multiplies volume by 8.

topics.title: 三角函数恒等式
topics.explain: 正弦、余弦表示单位圆坐标，正切表示斜率。
topics.explainEn: Sine and cosine are unit-circle coordinates; tangent represents slope.
topics.condition: 正切要求cosθ≠0；求导及弧长公式采用弧度。
topics.conditionEn: Tangent requires cosθ≠0; derivatives and arc formulas use radians.
topics.application: 坡度、振动合成；45°坡度的高差与水平距离相等。
topics.applicationEn: Slopes and combined oscillations; a 45° slope has equal rise and run.

topics.title: 正弦与余弦定理
topics.explain: 不局限于直角三角形的边角关系。
topics.explainEn: Side-angle relations valid beyond right triangles.
topics.formula: a/sin A=b/sin B=c/sin C=2R; c²=a²+b²−2ab cos C
topics.condition: 非退化三角形；R为外接圆半径。
topics.conditionEn: A nondegenerate triangle; R is its circumradius.
topics.application: 测量不可直达距离、三角定位。
topics.applicationEn: Survey inaccessible distances and triangulate positions.

topics.title: 解析几何与圆锥曲线
topics.explain: 用坐标方程描述直线、圆、椭圆、双曲线和抛物线。
topics.explainEn: Coordinates describe lines, circles, ellipses, hyperbolas and parabolas.
topics.formula: line ax+by+c=0; circle (x−h)²+(y−k)²=r²; ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1; parabola y²=4px
topics.condition: 椭圆a,b>0；抛物线p≠0；标准式假设中心、轴已选定。
topics.conditionEn: Ellipse axes are positive; p≠0; standard forms assume aligned axes and origin.
topics.application: 道路曲线、拱形断面、定位轨迹。
topics.applicationEn: Road curves, arch sections and position loci.

topics.title: 向量、点积与叉积
topics.explain: 点积度量投影与夹角，三维叉积给出法向及面积。
topics.explainEn: Dot products measure projections and angles; a 3D cross product gives normals and area.
topics.condition: 夹角计算要求两向量非零；此叉积在三维定向欧氏空间使用。
topics.conditionEn: Angle formulas require nonzero vectors; this cross product is for oriented 3D Euclidean space.
topics.application: 力分解、力矩、平面法线及三角面片面积。
topics.applicationEn: Force components, torque, plane normals and triangle mesh areas.

topics.title: 空间直线、平面与投影
topics.explain: 参数式描述空间直线，法向量描述平面。
topics.explainEn: Parametric equations describe lines; normal vectors describe planes.
topics.condition: v、n非零；距离公式为点到平面的垂距。
topics.conditionEn: v and n are nonzero; distance is perpendicular point-to-plane distance.
topics.application: BIM碰撞距离、构件定位与点云拟合。
topics.applicationEn: BIM clearance, component placement and point-cloud fitting.

topics.title: 微分几何与曲率
topics.explain: 曲率刻画曲线弯曲程度，曲面由局部度量和曲率描述。
topics.explainEn: Curvature measures bending of curves; local metrics and curvature describe surfaces.
topics.condition: 曲线至少二次可微且r′≠0；曲面结论需相应光滑性。
topics.conditionEn: A twice differentiable regular curve; surfaces require suitable smoothness.
topics.application: 道路曲率、轨道舒适性和壳体几何；圆的曲率为1/r。
topics.applicationEn: Road curvature, rail comfort and shell geometry; a circle has curvature 1/r.

topics.title: 贝塞尔曲线
topics.explain: 控制点决定曲线的形状；中间控制点通常不在曲线上。二次曲线可以通过两次线性插值构造。
topics.explainEn: Control points shape the curve; interior points generally do not lie on it. A quadratic curve is built by two stages of linear interpolation.
topics.condition: 此式为二次贝塞尔曲线；高阶曲线使用伯恩斯坦基。控制多边形不是实际曲线。
topics.conditionEn: This is the quadratic case; higher degrees use Bernstein polynomials. The control polygon is not the curve.
topics.application: CAD放样、路径平滑。取P₀=(0,0)、P₁=(1,2)、P₂=(2,0)，曲线中点为(1,1)。
topics.applicationEn: CAD and smooth paths. With P₀=(0,0), P₁=(1,2), P₂=(2,0), the midpoint is (1,1).
stepsEn: At t=1/2 the weights are 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4.
The weighted sum gives B(1/2)=(1,1).

topics.title: Voronoi最近点分区
topics.explain: 把平面按最近的站点划分，相邻区域边界是到两个站点等距离的位置。
topics.explainEn: Partition the plane by its nearest site. Boundaries consist of points equally distant from neighbouring sites.
topics.condition: 使用欧氏距离且站点不同。边界可能同时属于多个闭区域；实际道路距离会改变分区。
topics.conditionEn: Distinct sites and Euclidean distance are assumed. Closed cells share boundaries; road distance changes the partition.
topics.application: 仓库覆盖或传感器布点的初步分析，不能替代实际交通和容量约束。
topics.applicationEn: Preliminary warehouse coverage or sensor planning, without replacing travel-network or capacity constraints.
steps: 两站点(−1,0)与(1,0)的距离平方相等。
化简得到x=0，即垂直平分线。
stepsEn: Equate squared distances to (−1,0) and (1,0).
Simplification gives x=0, the perpendicular bisector.

topics.title: Delaunay三角剖分
topics.explain: 用站点构成三角形，使每个三角形外接圆内部没有其他站点。它与Voronoi分区相联系。
topics.explainEn: Connect sites into triangles whose circumcircle interiors contain no other sites. This construction is related to Voronoi regions.
topics.condition: 共圆时可能有多个合法剖分；三点共线不能形成三角形。
topics.conditionEn: Cocircular points may yield multiple valid triangulations; collinear triples do not form triangles.
topics.application: 测量地形三角网、网格生成。图示为单位正方形四个点的合法剖分。
topics.applicationEn: Terrain meshes and mesh generation. The figure shows a valid triangulation of four unit-square vertices.
steps: 两条对角线任选一条，均满足空圆内部条件。
stepsEn: The four square vertices are cocircular.
Either diagonal satisfies the empty-circle-interior condition.

topics.title: 悬链线
topics.explain: 理想均匀柔索仅受自身重力，在两端悬挂后形成双曲余弦曲线，并非一般抛物线。
topics.explainEn: A uniform flexible cable hanging under its own weight forms a hyperbolic-cosine curve, generally not a parabola.
topics.condition: 静力、柔索、单位弧长重量均匀；桥面荷载等其他载荷会改变形状。
topics.conditionEn: Static, flexible cable with uniform weight per arc length; other loads such as a deck change the shape.
topics.application: 初步理解悬索形状。图中平移到最低点y=0，不用于结构验算。
topics.applicationEn: Understand hanging-cable geometry. The figure shifts the lowest point to y=0 and is not a structural design calculation.
stepsEn: For a=2 and x=2, y=2cosh(1)≈3.086.
The height above the lowest point is y−a≈1.086.

topics.title: 集合、映射与逻辑
topics.explain: 集合描述对象范围，映射描述输入输出，量词把直觉写成可证明陈述。
topics.explainEn: Sets specify objects, mappings specify input-output rules, and quantifiers formalize claims.
topics.condition: 单射、满射都依赖指定的定义域和值域。
topics.conditionEn: Injectivity and surjectivity depend on the chosen domain and codomain.
topics.application: 数据库映射、函数反演和证明前提检查。
topics.applicationEn: Database mappings, function inversion and checking proof assumptions.

topics.title: 实数完备性
topics.explain: 实数轴没有有界递增序列所趋向的空缺，完备性支撑极限理论。
topics.explainEn: The real line has no gaps for bounded monotone sequences; completeness supports limit theory.
topics.formula: nonempty A⊂R bounded above ⇒ sup A∈R
topics.condition: 上确界公理针对非空且有上界的集合。
topics.conditionEn: The supremum property requires a nonempty set bounded above.
topics.application: 证明极限和最优解存在；有理数内√2的逼近可能无有理极限。
topics.applicationEn: Prove limits and optima exist; rational approximations to √2 have no rational limit.

topics.title: 数列极限与柯西准则
topics.explain: 极限控制尾部接近目标；柯西条件控制尾部各项彼此接近。
topics.explainEn: Limits control closeness to a target; the Cauchy condition controls mutual tail closeness.
topics.condition: 实数或复数空间中柯西序列必收敛；不完备空间未必。
topics.conditionEn: Cauchy sequences converge in real or complex complete spaces, not every space.
topics.application: 迭代算法收敛、误差界；1/n→0。
topics.applicationEn: Iterative convergence and error bounds; 1/n tends to 0.

topics.title: 函数极限与连续
topics.explain: 连续表示输入的小变化使输出保持接近，不保证可微。
topics.explainEn: Continuity makes small input changes produce small output changes, without implying differentiability.
topics.condition: 函数在a处有定义；极限定义通常排除x=a。
topics.conditionEn: The function is defined at a; the limit definition usually excludes x=a.
topics.application: 检查模型是否存在跳变；绝对值函数连续但在0不可微。
topics.applicationEn: Check models for jumps; absolute value is continuous but not differentiable at 0.

topics.title: 介值与极值定理
topics.explain: 连续函数不跳过中间值，紧区间上的连续实函数达到最大最小值。
topics.explainEn: Continuous functions attain intermediate values and reach extrema on compact intervals.
topics.condition: 介值定理要求闭区间连续；极值定理要求非空紧集。
topics.conditionEn: Continuity on the closed interval; extrema require a nonempty compact domain.
topics.application: 二分求根和可行范围验证；x³−2在[1,2]有根。
topics.applicationEn: Bisection and feasible-range checks; x³−2 has a root in [1,2].

topics.title: 单调、有界与一致连续
topics.explain: 一致连续的输入容差可同时用于整个定义域，比逐点连续更强。
topics.explainEn: Uniform continuity uses a single input tolerance over the whole domain, stronger than pointwise continuity.
topics.condition: 紧集上的连续函数一致连续；无界域不一定。
topics.conditionEn: Continuous functions on compact sets are uniformly continuous; unbounded domains need not be.
topics.application: 为全域插值设置统一误差；x²在R上不一致连续。
topics.applicationEn: Uniform interpolation error controls; x² is not uniformly continuous on R.

topics.title: 数项级数与收敛判别
topics.explain: 无穷和由部分和极限定义；通项趋零必要但不充分。
topics.explainEn: An infinite sum is a limit of partial sums; terms tending to zero are necessary but insufficient.
topics.formula: Σ1/n diverges; Σ1/nᵖ converges iff p>1; ratio limit L<1 ⇒ absolute convergence
topics.condition: 比值判别L=1不作结论；绝对收敛推出收敛。
topics.conditionEn: A ratio limit of 1 is inconclusive; absolute convergence implies convergence.
topics.application: 累计误差、级数近似；调和级数展示通项趋零仍可发散。
topics.applicationEn: Accumulated errors and series approximations; the harmonic series shows why vanishing terms are insufficient.

topics.title: 幂级数与收敛半径
topics.explain: 幂级数在中心附近将函数写成多项式的无穷极限。
topics.explainEn: A power series represents a function as a limit of polynomials near a center.
topics.condition: abs(x−c)<R绝对收敛，>R发散，端点分别检查。
topics.conditionEn: Absolute convergence inside the radius, divergence outside; check endpoints individually.
topics.application: 指数、对数近似及数值算法；eˣ=Σxⁿ/n!。
topics.applicationEn: Exponential and logarithm approximations; eˣ=Σxⁿ/n!.

topics.title: 逐点收敛与一致收敛
topics.explain: 一致收敛要求所有输入位置的最大误差同时趋零。
topics.explainEn: Uniform convergence drives the maximum error over all inputs to zero simultaneously.
topics.condition: 一致极限保连续；换序求导通常还需导数一致收敛等额外条件。
topics.conditionEn: Uniform limits preserve continuity; differentiating limits needs additional derivative conditions.
topics.application: 函数逼近误差控制；xⁿ在[0,1]逐点收敛但不一致。
topics.applicationEn: Control approximation error; xⁿ converges pointwise but not uniformly on [0,1].

topics.title: 度量空间与巴拿赫不动点
topics.titleEn: Metric spaces and Banach fixed point theorem
topics.explain: 距离使抽象空间也能谈收敛；压缩映射通过反复迭代逼近唯一不动点。
topics.explainEn: A metric enables convergence in abstract spaces; contractions iteratively approach a unique fixed point.
topics.condition: 非空完备度量空间且T将空间映入自身。
topics.conditionEn: A nonempty complete metric space and a self-map contraction.
topics.application: 证明迭代法可靠；T(x)=cos x在[0,1]上有唯一不动点。
topics.applicationEn: Justify iterative methods; cos x has a unique fixed point on [0,1].

topics.title: 测度与勒贝格积分
topics.explain: 测度推广长度和面积，勒贝格积分按函数取值组织加权面积。
topics.explainEn: Measure generalizes length and area; Lebesgue integration organizes weighted area by function values.
topics.condition: 集合和函数须可测；一般函数还需检查可积性。
topics.conditionEn: Sets and functions must be measurable; integrability needs checking.
topics.application: 概率期望、极限交换和不连续函数积分。
topics.applicationEn: Probability expectations, exchanging limits and integrating discontinuous functions.

topics.title: 控制收敛与单调收敛
topics.explain: 给出积分与极限交换的充分条件，避免错误换序。
topics.explainEn: Provides sufficient conditions for exchanging integration and limits.
topics.condition: 控制收敛需要同一个可积控制函数；单调收敛要求非负。
topics.conditionEn: Dominated convergence needs one integrable bound; monotone convergence needs nonnegative functions.
topics.application: 概率极限、参数积分和近似模型的可靠性分析。
topics.applicationEn: Probability limits, parameter integrals and reliable model approximations.

topics.title: 卷积与系统响应
topics.explain: 把一个函数平移、翻转后与另一函数逐点相乘并积分，得到随位移变化的重叠量。
topics.explainEn: Shift and reverse one function, multiply it by another, and integrate to measure overlap as the shift changes.
topics.condition: 需保证积分存在；离散信号使用求和。卷积不是一般的逐点乘法。
topics.conditionEn: The integral must exist; discrete signals use a sum. Convolution is not ordinary pointwise multiplication.
topics.application: 信号平滑与线性时不变系统响应。两个[0,1]上的单位矩形卷积得到三角形。
topics.applicationEn: Smoothing and linear time-invariant response. Two unit rectangles on [0,1] convolve to a triangle.
stepsEn: At t=0.5 the overlap has length 0.5.
At t=1 it is 1; at t=1.5 it falls to 0.5.

topics.title: 矩阵运算与线性方程组
topics.explain: 矩阵把多个线性关系组织为统一运算，消元把方程化为阶梯形。
topics.explainEn: Matrices organize linear relations; elimination transforms systems into echelon form.
topics.condition: 乘法要求内维相同；AB通常不等于BA。
topics.conditionEn: Inner dimensions must match; matrix multiplication is generally noncommutative.
topics.application: 节点平衡、工程量分配、多变量模型。
topics.applicationEn: Nodal balance, quantity allocation and multivariable models.

topics.title: 秩与解的结构
topics.explain: 秩为独立约束数量，决定方程组相容性和自由变量。
topics.explainEn: Rank counts independent constraints and determines consistency and free variables.
topics.formula: Ax=b solvable ⇔ rank A=rank[A b]; dim ker A=n−rank A
topics.condition: A为m×n矩阵，系数在同一域上。
topics.conditionEn: A is m×n over one field.
topics.application: 识别冗余约束和欠定模型；满列秩相容系统解唯一。
topics.applicationEn: Identify redundant constraints and underdetermined models; a consistent full-column-rank system is unique.

topics.title: 行列式与逆矩阵
topics.explain: 行列式度量有向体积缩放，非零意味着方阵可逆。
topics.explainEn: A determinant measures signed volume scaling; a nonzero value means a square matrix is invertible.
topics.formula: det(AB)=det A det B; det A≠0 ⇔ A⁻¹ exists
topics.condition: 只对方阵定义普通行列式和双侧逆。
topics.conditionEn: Ordinary determinants and two-sided inverses require square matrices.
topics.application: 坐标变换、判断奇异；实际求解通常用分解而非显式求逆。
topics.applicationEn: Coordinate changes and singularity detection; solve with factorizations rather than explicit inversion.

topics.title: 向量空间、基与维数
topics.explain: 基是能唯一表示每个向量的一组线性无关向量。
topics.explainEn: A basis is a linearly independent set giving a unique representation of every vector.
topics.formula: v=Σᵢcᵢbᵢ; dim V=number of basis vectors (finite-dimensional)
topics.condition: 子空间须包含零向量并对加法及数乘封闭。
topics.conditionEn: A subspace contains zero and is closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
topics.application: 选择独立状态变量，表达结构振型和多项式空间。
topics.applicationEn: Choose independent state variables; represent structural modes and polynomial spaces.

topics.title: 线性映射与换基
topics.explain: 线性映射保持线性组合，矩阵随基改变但映射不变。
topics.explainEn: Linear maps preserve combinations; matrix representations change with the basis.
topics.condition: 相似变换用于同一线性算子；P可逆。
topics.conditionEn: Similarity represents the same operator; P must be invertible.
topics.application: 坐标旋转、系统简化和解耦。
topics.applicationEn: Coordinate rotations, system simplification and decoupling.

topics.title: 特征值与特征向量
topics.explain: 特征向量经算子作用只发生尺度改变，用于识别固有模式。
topics.explainEn: Eigenvectors change only by a scalar and identify intrinsic modes.
topics.condition: A为方阵；实矩阵可能只有复特征值。
topics.conditionEn: A is square; real matrices can have complex eigenvalues.
topics.application: 结构振动、稳定性；对角矩阵的特征值就是对角元素。
topics.applicationEn: Structural vibration and stability; diagonal entries are eigenvalues of a diagonal matrix.

topics.title: 对角化与若尔当形式
topics.explain: 足够多独立特征向量可对角化，否则用若尔当块描述耦合。
topics.explainEn: Enough independent eigenvectors permit diagonalization; otherwise Jordan blocks describe coupling.
topics.formula: A=PDP⁻¹; Jordan block J=λI+N with N nilpotent
topics.condition: n×n矩阵可对角化当且仅当有n个独立特征向量；复域总有若尔当形式。
topics.conditionEn: Diagonalization needs n independent eigenvectors; Jordan form exists over complex numbers.
topics.application: 计算矩阵幂和动力系统；重特征值不自动意味着不可对角化。
topics.applicationEn: Matrix powers and dynamics; repeated eigenvalues do not by themselves prevent diagonalization.

topics.title: 内积、正交与格拉姆施密特
topics.explain: 内积提供长度和夹角，正交化把独立向量转为正交基。
topics.explainEn: Inner products define length and angle; orthogonalization constructs an orthonormal basis.
topics.condition: 输入向量线性无关；复内积须使用共轭。
topics.conditionEn: Input vectors are independent; complex inner products use conjugation.
topics.application: 消除变量相关性、QR分解及最小二乘计算。
topics.applicationEn: Reduce dependent directions, compute QR and solve least squares.

topics.title: 最小二乘与投影
topics.explain: 无精确解时选择残差平方和最小的近似解。
topics.explainEn: When no exact solution exists, minimize the squared residual.
topics.condition: 显式逆公式要求满列秩；数值计算宜用QR或SVD。
topics.conditionEn: The inverse formula requires full column rank; prefer QR or SVD numerically.
topics.application: 数据拟合、测量平差；残差与A的列空间正交。
topics.applicationEn: Data fitting and survey adjustment; residuals are orthogonal to the column space.

topics.title: 谱定理与正定矩阵
topics.explain: 实对称矩阵可用正交特征向量分解，正定意味着所有非零方向二次型为正。
topics.explainEn: Real symmetric matrices admit an orthonormal eigenbasis; positive definiteness makes the quadratic form positive.
topics.condition: 此等价在实对称矩阵下成立；复数用厄米矩阵。
topics.conditionEn: This equivalence assumes real symmetry; complex matrices use Hermitian symmetry.
topics.application: 刚度矩阵、凸二次优化和能量最小化。
topics.applicationEn: Stiffness matrices, convex quadratic optimization and energy minimization.

topics.title: 奇异值分解
topics.explain: 任意实矩阵可分解成正交变换和非负伸缩，不要求方阵或可逆。
topics.explainEn: Any real matrix decomposes into orthogonal transformations and nonnegative scaling, without being square or invertible.
topics.condition: 奇异值非负；复矩阵用共轭转置。
topics.conditionEn: Singular values are nonnegative; complex matrices use conjugate transposes.
topics.application: 降噪、低秩逼近、病态诊断；截断小奇异值抑制噪声。
topics.applicationEn: Denoising, low-rank approximation and conditioning diagnostics; truncate small singular values.

topics.title: 广义逆与条件数
topics.explain: 广义逆处理非满秩系统，条件数度量输入扰动被放大的程度。
topics.explainEn: The pseudoinverse handles rank deficiency; conditioning measures amplification of input perturbations.
topics.condition: Σ⁺仅对非零奇异值取倒数；奇异方阵条件数为无穷。
topics.conditionEn: Only nonzero singular values are reciprocated; singular square matrices have infinite condition number.
topics.application: 欠定系统最小范数解，检测测量拟合的不可靠性。
topics.applicationEn: Minimum-norm underdetermined solutions and unreliable fits.

topics.title: 二次型与主成分分析
topics.explain: 二次型描述方向相关的能量或离散程度；PCA寻找最大方差正交方向。
topics.explainEn: Quadratic forms describe directional energy or variability; PCA finds orthogonal maximum-variance directions.
topics.condition: PCA数据按列中心化；不同量纲通常先标准化。
topics.conditionEn: Center data columns for PCA; differing units often need standardization.
topics.application: 传感器降维、相关指标合并；主成分不自动具有因果含义。
topics.applicationEn: Sensor dimensionality reduction and correlated indicators; components do not establish causation.

topics.title: 矩阵指数与线性系统
topics.explain: 矩阵指数把标量指数推广到线性微分方程。
topics.explainEn: The matrix exponential generalizes scalar exponentials to linear differential equations.
topics.condition: A为常矩阵；时变矩阵需另外处理，不可任意交换乘法。
topics.conditionEn: A is constant; time-varying matrices require additional treatment and ordering.
topics.application: 状态空间仿真、控制系统响应和振动分析。
topics.applicationEn: State-space simulation, control responses and vibration analysis.

topics.title: 导数与微分
topics.explain: 导数是局部变化率，微分给出一阶线性近似。
topics.explainEn: A derivative is a local rate; a differential gives a first-order linear approximation.
topics.condition: 极限存在才可导；可导必连续，反之不成立。
topics.conditionEn: The limit must exist; differentiability implies continuity, not conversely.
topics.application: 速度、边际成本；f(x)=x²在x=3的变化率为6。
topics.applicationEn: Velocity and marginal cost; x² has rate 6 at x=3.

topics.title: 基本求导与链式法则
topics.explain: 乘积、商与复合函数分别按结构求导。
topics.explainEn: Products, quotients and compositions have structural derivative rules.
topics.condition: 商的分母非零；复合内外函数在相应位置可导。
topics.conditionEn: A quotient denominator is nonzero; both functions are differentiable at relevant points.
topics.application: 复杂模型灵敏度；sin(x²)的导数为2x cos(x²)。
topics.applicationEn: Model sensitivity; the derivative of sin(x²) is 2x cos(x²).

topics.title: 常用导数表
topics.explain: 幂、指数、对数和三角函数构成常用求导基础。
topics.explainEn: Powers, exponentials, logarithms and trigonometric functions form a derivative toolkit.
topics.condition: ln x实值要求x>0；一般实幂使用其可微定义域；角度为弧度。
topics.conditionEn: Real ln requires x>0; real powers use their differentiable domains; angles are radians.
topics.application: 增长、衰减和周期变化的速率计算。
topics.applicationEn: Rates of growth, decay and periodic change.

topics.title: 中值定理与洛必达法则
topics.titleEn: Mean value theorem and L’Hôpital rule
topics.explain: 中值定理联系平均和瞬时变化；洛必达在规定条件下求不定式极限。
topics.explainEn: The mean value theorem connects average and instantaneous rates; L’Hôpital evaluates certain indeterminate limits.
topics.condition: 中值定理需闭区间连续、开区间可导；洛必达需0/0或∞/∞、g′≠0及导数比极限存在。
topics.conditionEn: Continuity on [a,b], differentiability inside; L’Hôpital needs 0/0 or ∞/∞, nonzero g′ and an appropriate derivative-ratio limit.
topics.application: 限速估计；limₓ→₀ sin x/x=1。
topics.applicationEn: Rate bounds; sin x/x tends to 1 at 0.

topics.title: 泰勒展开与余项
topics.explain: 在一点附近用导数构造多项式近似，并用余项控制误差。
topics.explainEn: Derivatives construct a local polynomial approximation; a remainder controls its error.
topics.condition: 拉格朗日余项要求相应区间上足够阶可微；光滑不保证等于无穷泰勒级数。
topics.conditionEn: The Lagrange remainder needs sufficient differentiability; smoothness does not guarantee equality to an infinite Taylor series.
topics.application: 近似sin x≈x−x³/6，估算小位移误差。
topics.applicationEn: Approximate sin x by x−x³/6 and estimate small-displacement errors.

topics.title: 极值、凸凹与拐点
topics.explain: 一阶导数定位驻点，二阶导数描述弯曲与局部极值。
topics.explainEn: First derivatives identify stationary points; second derivatives describe curvature and local extrema.
topics.formula: f′(a)=0; f″(a)>0 ⇒ strict local minimum; f″≥0 ⇒ convex on an interval
topics.condition: 极值也可能出现在不可导点或边界；f″=0不能单独判定拐点。
topics.conditionEn: Extrema may occur at nondifferentiable points or boundaries; f″=0 alone does not establish inflection.
topics.application: 最小材料用量、经济订货；x²在0取得最小值。
topics.applicationEn: Minimize material or inventory costs; x² is minimized at 0.

topics.title: 不定积分与基本积分表
topics.explain: 不定积分寻找导数等于给定函数的函数族。
topics.explainEn: An indefinite integral finds the family of functions with a specified derivative.
topics.condition: 各式在定义域的连通区间内使用；积分常数不能省略。
topics.conditionEn: Use connected intervals within the domain; retain the integration constant.
topics.application: 从加速度恢复速度、累计量反推。
topics.applicationEn: Recover velocity from acceleration and reconstruct accumulated quantities.

topics.title: 定积分与微积分基本定理
topics.explain: 定积分累计带符号的变化量；原函数把累计计算转为端点差。
topics.explainEn: A definite integral accumulates signed change; an antiderivative turns it into endpoint subtraction.
topics.condition: 连续函数满足此基本形式；更一般版本有额外条件。
topics.conditionEn: This basic form assumes continuity; broader versions need other hypotheses.
topics.application: 流量积分得体积；恒定2m³/h流3小时得到6m³。
topics.applicationEn: Integrate flow to obtain volume; 2 m³/h for 3 hours gives 6 m³.

topics.title: 换元与分部积分
topics.explain: 换元利用复合结构，分部积分利用乘积求导的逆过程。
topics.explainEn: Substitution exploits composition; integration by parts reverses the product rule.
topics.condition: 定积分换元同时更改积分限；分部所用函数须足够光滑。
topics.conditionEn: Change definite-integral bounds on substitution; integration by parts needs suitable regularity.
topics.application: ∫xeˣdx=eˣ(x−1)+C；用于力矩、能量积分。
topics.applicationEn: ∫xeˣdx=eˣ(x−1)+C; useful in moment and energy integrals.

topics.title: 反常积分
topics.explain: 对无穷区间或无界被积函数，通过极限定义积分。
topics.explainEn: Limits define integrals over infinite intervals or unbounded integrands.
topics.formula: ∫₁∞ x⁻ᵖdx converges iff p>1; ∫₀¹ x⁻ᵖdx converges iff p<1
topics.condition: 必须分别检查每个奇点或无穷端；柯西主值不等于普通收敛。
topics.conditionEn: Check each singularity and infinite endpoint separately; principal value is not ordinary convergence.
topics.application: 无限时间衰减总量、概率密度归一化。
topics.applicationEn: Total long-term decay and probability-density normalization.

topics.title: 偏导数、梯度与全微分
topics.titleEn: Partial derivatives, gradient and total differential
topics.explain: 偏导一次只改变一个变量，梯度给出最陡上升方向。
topics.explainEn: A partial derivative changes one variable; the gradient gives steepest ascent.
topics.condition: 全微分需可微；偏导存在本身不保证可微；u为单位向量。
topics.conditionEn: A total differential requires differentiability, not merely existence of partials; u is a unit vector.
topics.application: 多因素敏感性、温度场和误差传播。
topics.applicationEn: Multifactor sensitivity, temperature fields and error propagation.

topics.title: 多元极值与拉格朗日乘子
topics.explain: 约束极值处目标梯度与约束梯度满足平衡关系。
topics.explainEn: At constrained stationary points, objective and constraint gradients balance.
topics.condition: 单约束此式要求∇g≠0；必要条件不是全局最优保证。
topics.conditionEn: This single-constraint form needs a nonzero constraint gradient; stationarity does not guarantee global optimality.
topics.application: 限定材料下最大容积、固定预算最优分配。
topics.applicationEn: Maximize volume under material limits and allocate a fixed budget.

topics.title: 重积分与变量替换
topics.titleEn: Multiple integrals and change of variables
topics.explain: 多重积分在区域上累计，雅可比因子校正坐标变换面积或体积。
topics.explainEn: Multiple integrals accumulate over regions; a Jacobian adjusts area or volume under coordinate changes.
topics.formula: ∫∫_D f(x,y)dxdy=∫∫ f(x(u,v),y(u,v)) abs(det J) du dv; polar dxdy=r dr dθ
topics.condition: 变换在区域内部适当光滑且一一对应，除可忽略集合外雅可比非零。
topics.conditionEn: A suitably smooth, one-to-one transformation with nonzero Jacobian except on negligible sets.
topics.application: 计算不规则体积、质量、质心及极惯性矩。
topics.applicationEn: Compute irregular volumes, mass, centroids and polar moments.

topics.title: 曲线积分与保守场
topics.explain: 沿路径累计标量或向量场作用，保守场积分只依赖端点。
topics.explainEn: Accumulate a field along a path; conservative integrals depend only on endpoints.
topics.condition: 无旋推出保守还需区域拓扑等条件，常用充分条件为单连通域且场C¹。
topics.conditionEn: Curl-free implies conservative only with domain conditions, such as a simply connected domain and a C¹ field.
topics.application: 力做功、电势差；绕孔区域不能只凭旋度为零判断。
topics.applicationEn: Mechanical work and potential differences; holes in the domain matter.

topics.title: 格林、斯托克斯与散度定理
topics.explain: 把区域内部的微分量转为边界积分，是守恒定律的重要表达。
topics.explainEn: Converts interior differential quantities to boundary integrals and expresses conservation.
topics.formula: ∮_∂D Pdx+Qdy=∫∫_D(Qₓ−Pᵧ)dA; ∮_∂S F·dr=∫_S curl F·n dS; ∫_∂V F·n dS=∫_V div F dV
topics.condition: 区域与边界分片光滑、方向匹配且场足够光滑；散度边界取外法向。
topics.conditionEn: Piecewise smooth oriented boundaries and sufficiently smooth fields; divergence uses outward normals.
topics.application: 流体通量、电磁场、守恒方程及面积计算。
topics.applicationEn: Fluid flux, electromagnetic fields, conservation laws and area calculation.

topics.title: 傅里叶级数
topics.explain: 把周期函数分解为正弦和余弦的不同频率成分。
topics.explainEn: Decomposes periodic functions into sine and cosine frequencies.
topics.condition: 此式为2π周期；分片光滑时在跳点趋于左右极限平均值，非总是原值。
topics.conditionEn: This form is 2π-periodic; at jumps, piecewise smooth series converge to the average of one-sided limits.
topics.application: 振动频谱、周期荷载和信号滤波。
topics.applicationEn: Vibration spectra, periodic loads and signal filtering.

topics.title: 概率公理与事件运算
topics.explain: 概率是事件集合上的非负、归一且可列可加的度量。
topics.explainEn: Probability is a nonnegative normalized countably additive measure on events.
topics.condition: 可列可加要求事件两两不交；概率不是样本频率的简单同义词。
topics.conditionEn: Countable additivity is for disjoint events; probability and observed frequency are distinct concepts.
topics.application: 可靠性风险组合、事件树和事故概率估计。
topics.applicationEn: Reliability risks, event trees and accident probabilities.

topics.title: 条件概率与独立性
topics.explain: 条件概率反映已有信息下的概率；独立性意味着信息不改变概率。
topics.explainEn: Conditional probability accounts for known information; independence means it leaves probabilities unchanged.
topics.condition: 条件事件P(B)>0；互斥通常不等于独立。
topics.conditionEn: The conditioning event has positive probability; disjoint events are generally not independent.
topics.application: 多设备故障建模；不可未经检验假定各故障独立。
topics.applicationEn: Model equipment failures without assuming independence uncritically.

topics.title: 全概率与贝叶斯定理
topics.explain: 全概率按来源分解，贝叶斯公式根据证据更新来源概率。
topics.explainEn: Total probability partitions by sources; Bayes updates source probabilities using evidence.
topics.condition: Aᵢ构成事件划分，相关分母为正。
topics.conditionEn: The Aᵢ partition the sample space and required denominators are positive.
topics.application: 检测阳性后的缺陷概率；必须考虑原始缺陷率。
topics.applicationEn: Defect probability after a positive test; account for base defect rates.

topics.title: 随机变量与分布函数
topics.explain: 随机变量把结果映射到数值，分布函数统一描述离散与连续分布。
topics.explainEn: A random variable maps outcomes to numbers; a distribution function covers discrete and continuous laws.
topics.condition: F单调、右连续，极限为0和1；密度存在时f≥0且积分为1。
topics.conditionEn: F is nondecreasing and right-continuous, with limits 0 and 1; densities are nonnegative and normalized.
topics.application: 建立工期、成本和测量误差的不确定性模型。
topics.applicationEn: Model uncertain durations, costs and measurement errors.

topics.title: 期望、方差与协方差
topics.explain: 期望表示平均水平，方差量化波动，协方差描述共同变化。
topics.explainEn: Expectation gives a mean level; variance measures spread and covariance joint variation.
topics.condition: 均值需相应可积性；方差和协方差需有限二阶矩。
topics.conditionEn: Means require integrability; variance and covariance require finite second moments.
topics.application: 总成本均值可相加，方差相加还需处理协方差。
topics.applicationEn: Add mean costs directly; variances also require covariance terms.

topics.title: 伯努利与二项分布
topics.explain: 二项分布统计固定次数独立同成功率试验的成功数。
topics.explainEn: The binomial law counts successes in a fixed number of independent equal-probability trials.
topics.condition: n为非负整数，0≤p≤1，试验独立且p不变。
topics.conditionEn: A nonnegative integer n, fixed p in [0,1], independent trials.
topics.application: 抽检缺陷数；批次相关或概率变化时不能直接套用。
topics.applicationEn: Count inspection defects; dependence or changing probabilities invalidate the simple model.

topics.title: 泊松分布与过程
topics.explain: 泊松分布用于给定区间中的计数；泊松过程增加独立增量和恒定发生率假设。
topics.explainEn: Poisson distributions model counts; Poisson processes add independent increments and a constant rate.
topics.condition: λ≥0；过程模型需检验独立增量和稳定发生率。
topics.conditionEn: λ≥0; process assumptions need checking for independent increments and stable rate.
topics.application: 单位时间故障、到达数量；不能自动解释集中爆发事件。
topics.applicationEn: Failures or arrivals per interval; clustered events need other models.

topics.title: 正态分布与标准化
topics.explain: 正态模型用均值与方差描述对称波动，标准化转换到标准正态。
topics.explainEn: A normal law models symmetric variation; standardization gives a standard normal variable.
topics.condition: σ>0；数据并非天然正态，需检查分布。
topics.conditionEn: σ>0; normality is a model assumption to examine.
topics.application: 尺寸公差、测量误差；正态下约95.45%落在μ±2σ。
topics.applicationEn: Dimensional tolerances and measurement error; about 95.45% lies within μ±2σ under normality.
stepsEn: Standardize with z=(x−μ)/σ.
For μ=0 and σ=1, about 68.27% lies in [−1,1].

topics.title: 指数分布与无记忆性
topics.explain: 常发生率模型的等待时间服从指数分布，无记忆性表示已等待时间不改变剩余分布。
topics.explainEn: A constant-rate waiting time is exponential; elapsed waiting does not change its residual law.
topics.condition: t≥0，λ>0；老化设备往往不符合恒定失效率。
topics.conditionEn: t≥0 and λ>0; aging equipment often violates constant hazard.
topics.application: 简单可靠性寿命和到达等待时间。
topics.applicationEn: Simple reliability lifetimes and interarrival waiting times.

topics.title: 大数定律与中心极限定理
topics.titleEn: Law of large numbers and central limit theorem
topics.explain: 大数定律使样本平均稳定，中心极限定理描述平均值的近似正态波动。
topics.explainEn: The law of large numbers stabilizes averages; the CLT describes approximately normal mean fluctuations.
topics.condition: 常用版本要求独立同分布；CLT需有限非零方差，极端重尾需另论。
topics.conditionEn: The standard version assumes IID samples; the CLT needs finite positive variance, with heavy tails requiring care.
topics.application: 抽样误差和大量小扰动；不能保证单次观测正态。
topics.applicationEn: Sampling error and many small disturbances; individual observations need not be normal.

topics.title: 马尔可夫与切比雪夫不等式
topics.explain: 仅凭低阶矩给出尾部概率上界，不要求已知完整分布。
topics.explainEn: Bounds tail probabilities from moments without a full distribution.
topics.condition: a>0；切比雪夫要求有限方差且k>0。
topics.conditionEn: a>0; Chebyshev needs finite variance and k>0.
topics.application: 缺乏分布数据时提供保守风险上界。
topics.applicationEn: Conservative risk bounds when distributional information is limited.

topics.title: 联合分布与变量变换
topics.explain: 联合分布描述多个变量的依赖，变换公式把密度换到新的坐标。
topics.explainEn: Joint laws describe dependence; transformation formulas move densities to new variables.
topics.condition: 变换公式此形式要求一一、可微且雅可比非零；多分支须求和。
topics.conditionEn: This form requires an invertible differentiable map with nonzero Jacobian; sum over branches otherwise.
topics.application: 总成本、比值及几何测量误差传播。
topics.applicationEn: Total costs, ratios and geometric error propagation.

topics.title: 马尔可夫链
topics.explain: 下一状态的条件分布只依赖当前状态，用转移矩阵推进状态概率。
topics.explainEn: The next-state conditional law depends on the current state; a transition matrix propagates probabilities.
topics.condition: 概率向量此处按行表示；有限不可约链有唯一平稳分布，收敛还需非周期。
topics.conditionEn: Row-vector convention; a finite irreducible chain has one stationary law, while convergence also needs aperiodicity.
topics.application: 设备健康状态、库存状态和流程转移。
topics.applicationEn: Equipment health, inventory states and workflow transitions.

topics.title: 蒙特卡洛与随机模拟
topics.explain: 用随机样本近似期望或积分，并报告抽样不确定性。
topics.explainEn: Random samples approximate expectations or integrals with sampling uncertainty.
topics.condition: 标准误此式要求独立样本且方差有限；模拟不修复错误输入模型。
topics.conditionEn: This standard error assumes independent finite-variance samples; simulation does not fix a bad model.
topics.application: 工期风险、成本超支概率；样本数增4倍约使标准误减半。
topics.applicationEn: Schedule risk and overrun probability; quadrupling samples roughly halves standard error.
steps: 在单位正方形内均匀独立抽样，统计落在四分之一单位圆内的比例。
用4×命中数/总数估计π；图示固定样本用于教学，不表示保证误差。
stepsEn: Sample independently and uniformly in a unit square and count points inside a quarter unit circle.
Estimate π by 4×hits/total; fixed teaching samples do not guarantee accuracy.

topics.title: 信息熵
topics.explain: 概率分布越难预测，平均信息量通常越大。确定结果没有不确定性。
topics.explainEn: A less predictable distribution generally carries more average information. A certain outcome has no uncertainty.
topics.condition: pᵢ≥0且和为1；此处是离散Shannon熵，单位bit，不与热力学熵混用。
topics.conditionEn: Probabilities are nonnegative and sum to one. This is discrete Shannon entropy in bits, not thermodynamic entropy.
topics.application: 编码和不确定性比较；公平二元结果的信息熵为1 bit。
topics.applicationEn: Coding and comparison of uncertainty; an unbiased binary outcome has entropy 1 bit.
stepsEn: At p=0 or 1, H=0.

topics.title: 描述统计与分位数
topics.explain: 描述中心、离散和尾部，不直接推断因果。
topics.explainEn: Summarizes center, spread and tails without directly inferring causation.
topics.condition: 样本方差n>1；分位数软件算法可能不同，需统一口径。
topics.conditionEn: Sample variance requires n>1; quantile conventions differ between software.
topics.application: 日报指标、工时和缺陷分布；中位数对极端值较稳健。
topics.applicationEn: Daily metrics, labor hours and defect distributions; medians resist outliers.

topics.title: 抽样、偏差与实验设计
topics.explain: 代表性、随机化和控制混杂决定统计推断是否可信。
topics.explainEn: Representativeness, randomization and control of confounders determine inference quality.
topics.condition: 抽样框遗漏、选择偏差和非响应不能靠增加样本量自动消除。
topics.conditionEn: Coverage, selection and nonresponse biases do not vanish merely by enlarging a sample.
topics.application: 分层抽检不同专业与楼层，避免只检查易到达位置。
topics.applicationEn: Stratify inspections by discipline and floor instead of sampling only accessible locations.

topics.title: 点估计与最大似然
topics.explain: 从样本选择参数；最大似然让已观测数据在模型下最可能。
topics.explainEn: Estimates parameters from samples; maximum likelihood maximizes the modeled probability of observed data.
topics.condition: 估计性质依赖模型与正则条件；小样本不保证无偏。
topics.conditionEn: Properties depend on the model and regularity; small-sample unbiasedness is not guaranteed.
topics.application: 正态均值MLE为样本均值；拟合寿命分布。
topics.applicationEn: The normal-mean MLE is the sample mean; fit lifetime distributions.

topics.title: 置信区间
topics.explain: 重复抽样中按同一规则生成的区间，以约定比例覆盖固定真参数。
topics.explainEn: Over repeated sampling, intervals built by a rule cover a fixed parameter at the stated rate.
topics.condition: 精确t区间要求独立正态样本；大样本近似另需条件。
topics.conditionEn: An exact t interval assumes independent normal observations; large-sample approximations need other conditions.
topics.application: 报告平均强度及不确定性；95%不是固定参数在本区间的频率概率。
topics.applicationEn: Report mean strength and uncertainty; frequentist 95% is a property of the procedure.

topics.title: 假设检验与p值
topics.explain: 检验衡量观测结果与原假设的相容程度，p值不是原假设为真的概率。
topics.explainEn: Tests assess compatibility with a null; a p-value is not the probability the null is true.
topics.formula: p=P_H₀(test statistic at least as extreme); reject if p≤α
topics.condition: 需预先指定检验、方向和显著性；不显著不证明无差异。
topics.conditionEn: Prespecify test, direction and significance; nonsignificance does not prove equality.
topics.application: 比较施工工艺，同时报告效应大小与置信区间。
topics.applicationEn: Compare construction methods while reporting effect sizes and confidence intervals.

topics.title: 线性回归与相关
topics.explain: 回归描述条件均值关系，相关度量线性关联但不证明因果。
topics.explainEn: Regression models conditional means; correlation measures linear association rather than causation.
topics.condition: 逆公式需满列秩；经典区间需误差假设，异方差宜用稳健方法。
topics.conditionEn: The inverse needs full rank; classical intervals need error assumptions, with robust methods for heteroskedasticity.
topics.application: 工程量与工时拟合；避免超出样本范围盲目外推。
topics.applicationEn: Fit quantity-hour relationships; avoid unsupported extrapolation.

topics.title: 方差分析
topics.explain: 比较多组均值，通过组间与组内变异的比值构造统计量。
topics.explainEn: Compares multiple group means through between-group and within-group variation.
topics.condition: 经典单因素ADEMO要求独立、正态组内误差及同方差。
topics.conditionEn: Classical one-way ADEMO assumes independent normal within-group errors and equal variances.
topics.application: 比较多个供应商强度；显著后还需处理多重比较。
topics.applicationEn: Compare several suppliers; significant results still need multiplicity-aware follow-up.

topics.title: 卡方检验与分类数据
topics.explain: 比较实际与假设下期望频数，用于拟合优度或列联表独立性。
topics.explainEn: Compares observed and expected counts for goodness-of-fit or contingency-table independence.
topics.condition: 样本独立且期望频数不能过小；稀疏表考虑精确检验。
topics.conditionEn: Independent observations and adequate expected counts; sparse tables may need exact tests.
topics.application: 缺陷类别与班组关系、质量类型比例是否变化。
topics.applicationEn: Relate defect categories to teams or detect changes in category proportions.

topics.title: 非参数检验与自助法
topics.explain: 非参数方法弱化分布形式假设；自助法从样本反复重采样评估统计量波动。
topics.explainEn: Nonparametric methods reduce distributional assumptions; bootstrap resamples observations to estimate variability.
topics.formula: bootstrap: sample n values with replacement, recompute θ̂, repeat B times
topics.condition: 秩检验仍有独立性等假设；时序和聚类数据不能直接按单点独立重采样。
topics.conditionEn: Rank tests still have assumptions; time-series or clustered samples need appropriate resampling.
topics.application: 偏态工时数据、复杂统计量区间估计。
topics.applicationEn: Skewed labor-hour data and intervals for complicated statistics.

topics.title: 贝叶斯估计与可信区间
topics.explain: 先验与似然合成为后验，可信区间按后验概率解释。
topics.explainEn: A prior and likelihood form a posterior; credible intervals have posterior probability meaning.
topics.condition: 结果依赖先验与模型；稀疏数据时先验影响可能较大。
topics.conditionEn: Results depend on prior and model; sparse data can be strongly prior-sensitive.
topics.application: 逐批更新缺陷率，并明确展示先验与证据。
topics.applicationEn: Update defect rates by batch and document prior and evidence.

topics.title: 时间序列与平稳性
topics.explain: 时间顺序形成自相关，趋势和季节项需区别于随机波动。
topics.explainEn: Time ordering creates autocorrelation; trends and seasonality differ from random variation.
topics.condition: AR(1)常用平稳条件abs(φ)<1，误差为适当白噪声。
topics.conditionEn: A standard stationarity condition is abs(φ)<1 with suitable white-noise innovations.
topics.application: 物资需求、进度偏差预测；不能把相关日数据当独立样本。
topics.applicationEn: Forecast demand and progress deviations; correlated daily data are not independent observations.

topics.title: 统计过程控制与多重检验
topics.explain: 控制图识别过程漂移；多次检验会增加偶然显著，需要调整。
topics.explainEn: Control charts detect process shifts; multiple tests increase false positives and need adjustment.
topics.formula: individual normal limits μ±3σ; Bonferroni threshold α/m
topics.condition: 控制界限不同于规格界限；控制图需稳定基线及适当分组假设。
topics.conditionEn: Control limits differ from specification limits; charts need a stable baseline and appropriate subgrouping.
topics.application: 持续监测质量；对多项指标同时报警时控制误报率。
topics.applicationEn: Monitor quality while controlling false alarms across many indicators.

topics.title: 拓扑空间与开集
topics.explain: 拓扑以开集定义邻近与连续，不必先指定距离。
topics.explainEn: A topology defines nearness and continuity through open sets without first choosing a metric.
topics.formula: τ contains ∅,X; arbitrary unions and finite intersections of members lie in τ
topics.condition: 闭集是开集的补集；无限交集不必为开集。
topics.conditionEn: Closed sets are complements of open sets; infinite intersections need not be open.
topics.application: 建立抽象收敛框架；实数上的开区间生成通常拓扑。
topics.applicationEn: Frameworks for abstract convergence; open intervals generate the usual real topology.

topics.title: 邻域、内部、闭包与边界
topics.explain: 内部是完全落在集合内的局部，闭包加入所有无法与之分离的极限位置。
topics.explainEn: Interior captures locally contained points; closure adds points inseparable from the set by neighborhoods.
topics.formula: int A=union of open subsets of A; cl A=intersection of closed supersets; ∂A=cl A\int A
topics.condition: 边界依赖所处空间及其拓扑。
topics.conditionEn: Boundary depends on the ambient space and topology.
topics.application: 几何边界、可行域；[0,1]在R中的边界为{0,1}。
topics.applicationEn: Geometric boundaries and feasible regions; [0,1] has boundary {0,1} in R.

topics.title: 连续映射与同胚
topics.explain: 连续映射拉回开集仍开；同胚是双向连续的双射，代表相同拓扑形状。
topics.explainEn: Continuous maps pull open sets back to open sets; a homeomorphism is a continuous bijection with continuous inverse.
topics.formula: f continuous ⇔ f⁻¹(U) open for every open U; X≅Y via a homeomorphism
topics.condition: 连续双射不自动是同胚；紧空间到豪斯多夫空间的连续双射是同胚。
topics.conditionEn: A continuous bijection need not be a homeomorphism; compact-to-Hausdorff bijections are.
topics.application: 识别可连续变形的形状；开区间与R同胚。
topics.applicationEn: Identify equivalent shapes; an open interval is homeomorphic to R.

topics.title: 子空间、积空间与商空间
topics.explain: 把已有空间限制、组合或按等价关系粘合，构造新空间。
topics.explainEn: Construct spaces by restriction, products or gluing equivalence classes.
topics.formula: subspace open: A∩U; product basis: ∏Uᵢ with finitely many Uᵢ≠Xᵢ; quotient: U open ⇔ q⁻¹(U) open
topics.condition: 积拓扑不同于无限维盒拓扑；商空间可能失去豪斯多夫性质。
topics.conditionEn: Product topology differs from infinite box topology; quotients may fail to be Hausdorff.
topics.application: 端点粘合得圆，矩形两组对边粘合得环面。
topics.applicationEn: Glue interval endpoints to make a circle and rectangle edges to make a torus.

topics.title: 紧致性与海涅博雷尔
topics.explain: 紧致性要求任何开覆盖都有有限子覆盖，是有限性的重要替代。
topics.explainEn: Compactness requires every open cover to admit a finite subcover, replacing many uses of finiteness.
topics.formula: K⊂Rⁿ compact ⇔ K closed and bounded; continuous image of compact is compact
topics.condition: 闭且有界等价只在有限维欧氏空间等特定环境成立，不可推广到所有度量空间。
topics.conditionEn: Closed-and-bounded equivalence holds in finite-dimensional Euclidean space, not all metric spaces.
topics.application: 保证连续目标达到最优；证明算法搜索范围完备。
topics.applicationEn: Ensure continuous objectives attain optima and justify bounded searches.

topics.title: 连通与道路连通
topics.explain: 连通表示不能分成两个分离开部分；道路连通进一步要求点之间可用连续路径连接。
topics.explainEn: Connected spaces do not split into separated open parts; path connected spaces join points by continuous paths.
topics.formula: path connected ⇒ connected; connected subsets of R are intervals
topics.condition: 反向一般不成立；拓扑学正弦曲线提供典型反例。
topics.conditionEn: The converse fails in general; the topologist’s sine curve is a standard counterexample.
topics.application: 判断可行域是否分裂、机器人是否有连续可达路径。
topics.applicationEn: Determine whether feasible regions split and whether a robot has a continuous route.

topics.title: 分离公理与豪斯多夫空间
topics.explain: 分离公理规定点或集合能否用开集区别，豪斯多夫空间中极限具有唯一性。
topics.explainEn: Separation axioms distinguish points or sets using neighborhoods; Hausdorff limits are unique.
topics.formula: T₂: x≠y ⇒ ∃ disjoint open U∋x,V∋y; compact subsets of Hausdorff spaces are closed
topics.condition: 不同教材对正则、正规公理是否包含T₁的约定可能不同。
topics.conditionEn: Conventions for regular and normal spaces may or may not include T₁.
topics.application: 避免商空间中点无法分离导致的几何歧义。
topics.applicationEn: Avoid ambiguous geometric points in badly behaved quotient spaces.

topics.title: 可数性、基与可度量化
topics.explain: 基用少量开集生成拓扑，可数性帮助连接抽象拓扑与序列方法。
topics.explainEn: A basis generates open sets; countability links abstract topology to sequence methods.
topics.formula: second countable ⇒ first countable; regular T₁ + second countable ⇒ metrizable
topics.condition: 可度量化结论为乌雷松可度量化定理；一般拓扑中序列不能刻画所有闭包。
topics.conditionEn: The metrization statement is Urysohn’s theorem; sequences need not characterize all closures in general spaces.
topics.application: 判断能否用距离实现抽象数据空间与收敛判定。
topics.applicationEn: Determine when abstract data spaces admit useful distance-based implementations.

topics.title: 同伦与形变收缩
topics.explain: 同伦是映射之间的连续变化，形变收缩保留许多孔洞结构。
topics.explainEn: A homotopy continuously changes one map into another; deformation retractions preserve many hole invariants.
topics.condition: 同伦等价比同胚弱；收缩还需在目标子空间上保持相应固定条件。
topics.conditionEn: Homotopy equivalence is weaker than homeomorphism; retractions impose fixed-subspace conditions.
topics.application: 环带可形变收缩到圆；简化空间以计算拓扑不变量。
topics.applicationEn: An annulus retracts onto a circle; simplify spaces to compute invariants.

topics.title: 基本群与单连通
topics.explain: 基本群记录以基点为端点的闭路如何在连续变形下组合。
topics.explainEn: The fundamental group records based loops modulo continuous deformation and their concatenation.
topics.formula: π₁(S¹)≅Z; π₁(Rⁿ)={e}; simply connected = path connected with trivial π₁
topics.condition: 同伦固定基点；π₁依赖基点但道路连通空间中各基点群同构。
topics.conditionEn: Homotopies fix the basepoint; groups at different points are isomorphic in path-connected spaces.
topics.application: 识别障碍绕行类别，解释无旋场为何在有孔区域可能非保守。
topics.applicationEn: Classify routes around obstacles and explain nonconservative curl-free fields on domains with holes.

topics.title: 覆盖空间与提升
topics.explain: 覆盖空间在每个小邻域看起来像互不相交的多层副本。
topics.explainEn: A covering space locally looks like disjoint copies of each small neighborhood.
topics.condition: 路径提升指定起点后唯一；用子群分类覆盖需适当连通及局部条件。
topics.conditionEn: A path lift is unique with a specified starting point; subgroup classifications need local hypotheses.
topics.application: 处理角度绕圈次数、周期变量与多值函数。
topics.applicationEn: Track winding, periodic variables and multivalued functions.

topics.title: 同调、贝蒂数与欧拉示性数
topics.titleEn: Homology, Betti numbers and Euler characteristic
topics.explain: 同调通过链、边界与循环代数化孔洞；贝蒂数记录各维独立洞数。
topics.explainEn: Homology algebraizes holes using chains and boundaries; Betti numbers count independent holes by dimension.
topics.condition: 贝蒂数通常在域系数下取维数；欧拉交错和要求有限型等条件。
topics.conditionEn: Betti numbers are dimensions over a coefficient field; finite-type conditions justify the Euler sum.
topics.application: 网格拓扑检测；连通闭合可定向亏格g曲面χ=2−2g。
topics.applicationEn: Mesh topology checks; a connected closed orientable genus-g surface has χ=2−2g.

topics.title: 流形与局部坐标
topics.explain: 流形局部像欧氏空间，但整体可弯曲或有复杂拓扑。
topics.explainEn: Manifolds locally resemble Euclidean space while permitting curved or complicated global structure.
topics.formula: chart φ:U→V⊂Rⁿ is a homeomorphism; smooth charts have smooth transition maps
topics.condition: 常规定义要求豪斯多夫且第二可数；有边界流形局部使用半空间。
topics.conditionEn: Standard definitions require Hausdorff and second-countable spaces; boundaries use half-space charts.
topics.application: 曲面建模、姿态空间；球面为二维流形，不是单张平面坐标可全覆盖。
topics.applicationEn: Surface models and pose spaces; a sphere is a 2-manifold without one global planar chart.

topics.title: 不动点与拓扑不变量
topics.explain: 不变量在指定等价下保持不变，用于证明空间不同；不动点定理保证某些映射有固定点。
topics.explainEn: Invariants survive chosen equivalences and distinguish spaces; fixed-point theorems ensure fixed points under hypotheses.
topics.condition: Bⁿ为闭单位球；非紧区域或不映入自身时不保证。
topics.conditionEn: Bⁿ is the closed unit ball; noncompact domains or non-self-maps need not qualify.
topics.application: 均衡存在性、证明非线性系统有解；存在不等于迭代一定收敛。
topics.applicationEn: Equilibrium and nonlinear existence; existence does not guarantee an iteration converges.

topics.title: 曲面分类与可定向性
topics.explain: 紧致连通曲面由可定向性、把手或交叉帽等结构分类。
topics.explainEn: Compact connected surfaces are classified using orientability, handles or crosscaps.
topics.formula: closed orientable: χ=2−2g; closed nonorientable: χ=2−k
topics.condition: 此公式针对无边界紧致连通曲面；边界分量b额外减去b。
topics.conditionEn: These formulas assume closed compact connected surfaces; each boundary component subtracts one.
topics.application: 检查模型是否可统一设定法向；莫比乌斯带不可定向。
topics.applicationEn: Check whether a model admits consistent normals; the Möbius band is nonorientable.

topics.title: 持久同调与拓扑数据分析
topics.titleEn: Persistent homology and topological data analysis
topics.explain: 在尺度逐渐变化的复形上追踪洞的出生与消失，区分持续结构与短暂噪声。
topics.explainEn: Tracks births and deaths of holes as a filtration changes scale, separating persistent structure from transient features.
topics.condition: 结果依赖距离、过滤规则、系数域和采样；持续时间长不自动证明物理意义。
topics.conditionEn: Results depend on metric, filtration, coefficients and sampling; persistence alone does not prove physical significance.
topics.application: 点云形态、传感器数据结构和孔洞识别。
topics.applicationEn: Point-cloud shape, sensor-data structure and hole detection.

topics.title: 莫比乌斯带
topics.explain: 把长方形纸带的一端转半圈再与另一端连接，得到不可定向的带边界曲面。
topics.explainEn: Join the ends of a rectangular strip after a half twist to obtain a nonorientable surface with boundary.
topics.condition: 具有一条边界分量。图为三维投影，遮挡和投影交叠不表示曲面真的自交。
topics.conditionEn: There is one boundary component. Occlusion or overlap in a 3D projection does not imply self-intersection.
topics.application: 用纸带理解局部与整体性质，检验沿闭合路径移动的局部法向是否反向。
topics.applicationEn: Use a paper strip to explore local versus global properties and reversal of a local normal along a closed path.
steps: 沿中心线走一圈回到原点，局部横向方向反转。
stepsEn: Twist one end by 180° before joining.
After one circuit of the centreline, the local transverse direction is reversed.

topics.title: 可分离变量方程
topics.explain: 把变量分到等式两侧积分，求得隐式或显式解。
topics.explainEn: Separate the variables and integrate to find an implicit or explicit solution.
topics.condition: 除以h(y)前先保留h(y)=0的常值解；检查初值与定义域。
topics.conditionEn: Retain constant solutions with h(y)=0 before division; check initial conditions and domain.
topics.application: 指数增长y′=ky得到y=y₀eᵏˣ，用于衰减和简单增长。
topics.applicationEn: Exponential growth y′=ky gives y=y₀eᵏˣ for decay and growth models.

topics.title: 一阶线性方程
topics.explain: 积分因子把方程左侧变为乘积导数。
topics.explainEn: An integrating factor turns the left side into a product derivative.
topics.condition: p、q在所考虑区间连续；积分常数结合初值确定。
topics.conditionEn: p and q are continuous on the interval; use initial conditions to determine constants.
topics.application: 冷却过程、线性蓄水和电路暂态。
topics.applicationEn: Cooling, linear storage and circuit transients.

topics.title: 常系数二阶方程
topics.explain: 特征方程的实根或复根决定指数、振荡及阻尼形式。
topics.explainEn: Characteristic roots determine exponential, oscillatory and damped behavior.
topics.condition: a≠0；重根需乘x，复根以指数乘正弦余弦表示。
topics.conditionEn: a≠0; repeated roots need an x factor, and complex roots give exponential-sinusoidal forms.
topics.application: 弹簧质量阻尼系统和结构振动。
topics.applicationEn: Mass-spring-damper systems and structural vibration.

topics.title: 存在唯一性与初值问题
topics.explain: 连续性支持局部存在，对状态的局部利普希茨条件常保证唯一性。
topics.explainEn: Continuity supports local existence; local Lipschitz dependence on state commonly guarantees uniqueness.
topics.formula: y′=f(t,y), y(t₀)=y₀; local Lipschitz in y ⇒ local uniqueness
topics.condition: 在初始点附近的矩形域要求相应条件；局部解可能有限时间爆破。
topics.conditionEn: Conditions hold near the initial point; a local solution may blow up in finite time.
topics.application: 检查仿真解是否唯一；y′=y²可能有限时间趋于无穷。
topics.applicationEn: Check whether simulations are unique; y′=y² can blow up in finite time.

topics.title: 非线性系统稳定性
topics.explain: 在平衡点附近线性化，或用能量型函数判断扰动是否衰减。
topics.explainEn: Linearize near equilibria or use an energy-like function to assess disturbances.
topics.formula: x′=f(x); J=Df(x*); Re λ(J)<0 ⇒ local asymptotic stability
topics.condition: f足够光滑；存在实部为零的特征值时线性化通常不能判定。
topics.conditionEn: f is sufficiently smooth; zero-real-part eigenvalues usually make linearization inconclusive.
topics.application: 控制系统、安全运行点；李雅普诺夫函数可给出更强判据。
topics.applicationEn: Control systems and safe operating points; Lyapunov functions provide additional criteria.

topics.title: 拉普拉斯变换
topics.explain: 把时间微分转为代数运算，并把初值纳入方程。
topics.explainEn: Transforms time differentiation into algebra while incorporating initial values.
topics.condition: 需函数局部可积并满足适当增长条件；公式使用单边变换。
topics.conditionEn: Local integrability and suitable growth conditions; formulas use the one-sided transform.
topics.application: 阶跃荷载、控制传递函数和电路响应。
topics.applicationEn: Step loads, transfer functions and circuit responses.

topics.title: 热方程、波动方程与拉普拉斯方程
topics.explain: 分别描述扩散、传播及稳态平衡，必须结合边界与初始条件。
topics.explainEn: Describe diffusion, propagation and steady equilibrium with boundary and initial conditions.
topics.condition: α>0、c>0；需选择适合物理问题的边界与初值，不能只给方程。
topics.conditionEn: α,c>0; choose physically appropriate boundary and initial conditions, not just an equation.
topics.application: 温度场、声振传播、稳态电势。
topics.applicationEn: Temperature fields, acoustic waves and steady electric potential.

topics.title: 分离变量与特征函数
topics.explain: 寻找乘积形式，把偏微分方程变为一组常微分方程。
topics.explainEn: A product ansatz reduces a PDE to ordinary differential equations.
topics.condition: 只适用于可分结构；边界条件决定特征值，通常还需叠加模态。
topics.conditionEn: Requires separability; boundary conditions select eigenvalues and modes must usually be superposed.
topics.application: 杆件传热、振型和矩形区域边值问题。
topics.applicationEn: Rod heat flow, vibration modes and rectangular boundary problems.

topics.title: Logistic增长与S曲线
topics.explain: 增长初期接近指数增长，随着接近容量上限，增长速度减小。
topics.explainEn: Growth is initially near exponential and slows as it approaches a limiting capacity.
topics.condition: r>0、K>0、0<N₀<K；不是任意项目的真实进度规律。
topics.conditionEn: r>0, K>0 and 0<N₀<K. This is not automatically a valid project-progress model.
topics.application: 用于讨论受限增长和拟合S形趋势，拟合前要检查数据。
topics.applicationEn: Discuss bounded growth or fit S-shaped trends after checking the data.
stepsEn: Growth is fastest at N=50, when t=ln9≈2.197.

topics.title: 命题逻辑与证明方法
topics.explain: 直接证明、逆否证明、反证和归纳各有适合结构，证明必须列明量词与前提。
topics.explainEn: Direct, contrapositive, contradiction and induction proofs suit different structures and require explicit assumptions.
topics.condition: 反命题Q⇒P不与原命题自动等价；归纳必须包含起点。
topics.conditionEn: The converse is not automatically equivalent; induction needs a base case.
topics.application: 算法正确性、递推关系和边界条件审查。
topics.applicationEn: Algorithm correctness, recurrences and boundary checks.

topics.title: 计数、排列与组合
topics.explain: 排列考虑顺序，组合不考虑顺序，乘法原理组合分步选择。
topics.explainEn: Permutations count ordered selections; combinations ignore order and multiplication combines stages.
topics.condition: 0≤k≤n为整数；此形式假设不重复选择。
topics.conditionEn: Integer 0≤k≤n; these forms assume selection without repetition.
topics.application: 排班方案数、抽检样本组合和概率计算。
topics.applicationEn: Count rosters, inspection samples and probability outcomes.

topics.title: 容斥原理与鸽巢原理
topics.explain: 容斥修正重复计数；鸽巢原理证明有限资源下必有冲突。
topics.explainEn: Inclusion-exclusion corrects overlap; pigeonhole reasoning proves unavoidable collisions.
topics.formula: abs(A∪B)=abs(A)+abs(B)−abs(A∩B); N objects in k boxes ⇒ one box has ≥ceil(N/k)
topics.condition: 基本计数形式针对有限集合。
topics.conditionEn: The basic counting forms concern finite sets.
topics.application: 重复人员去重、存储冲突和资源分配下界。
topics.applicationEn: Deduplicate staff and bound storage collisions or resource loads.

topics.title: 图、路径与树
topics.explain: 图表示实体与关系，树为连通且无环的无向图。
topics.explainEn: Graphs model entities and relations; a tree is connected and acyclic.
topics.formula: tree with n vertices: edges=n−1; undirected Σdegree=2m
topics.condition: 树的结论针对有限无向简单图；有向依赖需区别定义。
topics.conditionEn: These tree statements assume finite simple undirected graphs; directed dependencies need distinct definitions.
topics.application: 网络布线、组织结构和施工依赖。
topics.applicationEn: Network wiring, organizational structure and construction dependencies.

topics.title: 拓扑排序与关键路径
topics.explain: 有向无环图可按依赖先后排序，前推后推计算项目工期及总浮时。
topics.explainEn: A DAG admits dependency order; forward and backward passes give duration and total float.
topics.formula: FS zero-lag: ESᵢ=max EF_pred; EFᵢ=ESᵢ+dᵢ; LFᵢ=min LS_succ; TFᵢ=LSᵢ−ESᵢ
topics.condition: 此简式针对FS零间隔且无额外约束；SS/FF/SF、日历和约束需相应推广。
topics.conditionEn: This simplified form assumes zero-lag FS links; other relations, calendars and constraints need extensions.
topics.application: 施工网络计划、关键路线识别；有环依赖须先纠正。
topics.applicationEn: Construction scheduling and critical paths; fix cyclic dependencies before calculation.

topics.title: 最短路与最小生成树
topics.titleEn: Shortest paths and minimum spanning trees
topics.explain: 最短路优化指定起终点，最小生成树优化所有点的无环连通成本。
topics.explainEn: Shortest paths optimize endpoints; an MST minimizes the cost of connecting all vertices without cycles.
topics.formula: Dijkstra relaxation: d(v)=min(d(v),d(u)+w(u,v)); MST uses n−1 edges
topics.condition: Dijkstra要求边权非负；MST用于连通无向加权图。
topics.conditionEn: Dijkstra requires nonnegative weights; an MST assumes a connected undirected weighted graph.
topics.application: 运输路线、临时供电和通信线缆布置。
topics.applicationEn: Transport routes, temporary power and communication cabling.

topics.title: 最大流最小割
topics.explain: 网络流在容量和守恒约束下达到的最大流等于最小割容量。
topics.explainEn: The maximum feasible network flow equals the minimum cut capacity.
topics.formula: max abs(f)=min cut capacity; 0≤fₑ≤cₑ; inflow=outflow at internal nodes
topics.condition: 有限有向容量网络，源汇不同，容量非负。
topics.conditionEn: A finite directed network, distinct source and sink, nonnegative capacities.
topics.application: 物流瓶颈、管网通量上界及人员配置。
topics.applicationEn: Logistics bottlenecks, pipe-network bounds and staffing.

topics.title: 递推、生成函数与复杂度
topics.explain: 递推用小规模问题构造大问题，生成函数把序列转为代数对象，复杂度分析增长阶。
topics.explainEn: Recurrences build larger cases; generating functions encode sequences and complexity studies scaling.
topics.formula: Fₙ=Fₙ₋₁+Fₙ₋₂; G(x)=Σaₙxⁿ; T(n)=2T(n/2)+O(n) ⇒ O(n log n)
topics.condition: 生成函数可作为形式幂级数；递推复杂度需满足适用定理的条件。
topics.conditionEn: Generating functions may be formal; complexity bounds need their theorem assumptions.
topics.application: 动态规划、排程算法规模与性能估算。
topics.applicationEn: Dynamic programming, scheduling scale and performance estimation.

topics.title: 素数、整除与欧几里得算法
topics.explain: 素因子分解给出整数结构，辗转相除高效求最大公约数。
topics.explainEn: Prime factorization describes integers; Euclid’s algorithm efficiently computes their greatest common divisor.
topics.formula: gcd(a,b)=gcd(b,a mod b); ax+by=gcd(a,b) for some integers x,y
topics.condition: a,b不同时为0；正整数>1有唯一素因子分解（忽略顺序）。
topics.conditionEn: a,b are not both zero; positive integers above 1 have unique prime factorization up to order.
topics.application: 齿轮周期、批量分组与密码算法基础。
topics.applicationEn: Gear cycles, batch grouping and foundations of cryptographic algorithms.

topics.title: 图拉普拉斯矩阵
topics.explain: 度数矩阵减去邻接矩阵，得到描述节点间差异和连接结构的矩阵。
topics.explainEn: Subtract the adjacency matrix from the degree matrix to describe differences and connectivity between vertices.
topics.condition: 这里为无向、无权、无自环图，每条边在求和中只计一次。
topics.conditionEn: Here the graph is undirected, unweighted and has no loops; each edge is counted once.
topics.application: 网络连通性、扩散与谱聚类；零特征值重数等于连通分量数。
topics.applicationEn: Connectivity, diffusion and spectral clustering; the zero-eigenvalue multiplicity counts connected components.
stepsEn: For path 1—2—3, the degrees are 1, 2, 1.

topics.title: 解析函数与柯西黎曼方程
topics.explain: 复可微比实可微更严格，解析函数具有强烈局部结构。
topics.explainEn: Complex differentiability is stronger than real differentiability and gives strong local structure.
topics.condition: 偏导连续并满足方程是常用充分条件；孤立一点满足方程不保证邻域解析。
topics.conditionEn: Continuous partials satisfying these equations are a common sufficient condition; one-point equations do not establish neighborhood holomorphy.
topics.application: 二维势流、电场和共形映射模型。
topics.applicationEn: Planar potential flow, fields and conformal models.

topics.title: 柯西积分定理与公式
topics.explain: 解析性把区域内部函数值与边界积分联系起来。
topics.explainEn: Holomorphy relates interior values to boundary integrals.
topics.condition: C为适当正向简单闭曲线，f在曲线及内部邻域解析，z₀在内部。
topics.conditionEn: A positively oriented simple closed curve, holomorphy on its interior and neighborhood, and z₀ inside.
topics.application: 计算积分、证明解析函数无限可微及估计导数。
topics.applicationEn: Evaluate integrals and derive differentiability and derivative bounds.

topics.title: 洛朗级数与奇点
topics.explain: 解析函数在环域内用正负整数幂展开，负幂部分决定孤立奇点类型。
topics.explainEn: On an annulus, a holomorphic function has positive and negative powers; negative terms classify isolated singularities.
topics.condition: 展开对应指定环域；可去奇点、极点、本性奇点须分别处理。
topics.conditionEn: The expansion belongs to a specified annulus; removable, pole and essential cases differ.
topics.application: 分析传递函数极点、复积分和局部异常行为。
topics.applicationEn: Analyze transfer-function poles, contour integrals and local singular behavior.

topics.title: 留数定理
topics.explain: 闭合积分由内部孤立奇点处的留数总和决定。
topics.explainEn: A closed contour integral is determined by residues of enclosed isolated singularities.
topics.condition: 曲线避开奇点，满足相应解析与围绕条件；无穷多个奇点需额外检查。
topics.conditionEn: The contour avoids singularities and satisfies analytic and winding conditions; infinitely many poles need care.
topics.application: 实积分、反变换及振动响应计算。
topics.applicationEn: Real integrals, inverse transforms and vibration responses.

topics.title: 共形映射与调和函数
topics.explain: 非零导数的解析映射局部保角，解析函数实虚部满足拉普拉斯方程。
topics.explainEn: Holomorphic maps with nonzero derivative locally preserve angles; real and imaginary parts are harmonic.
topics.condition: 保角是局部结论；全局一一性须另检验。
topics.conditionEn: Angle preservation is local; global injectivity needs checking.
topics.application: 二维稳态传热、静电和流体边界变换。
topics.applicationEn: Planar steady heat, electrostatics and flow-boundary transformations.

topics.title: 辐角原理与鲁歇定理
topics.explain: 通过边界绕转计数内部零点与极点，并比较小扰动前后零点数。
topics.explainEn: Boundary winding counts zeros minus poles and compares zeros under small perturbations.
topics.formula: (1/2πi)∮f′/f dz=N−P; abs(g)<abs(f) on C ⇒ f,f+g have equal zero counts
topics.condition: 辐角原理要求边界无零极点；鲁歇要求内部及边界邻域解析。
topics.conditionEn: No boundary zeros or poles for the argument principle; Rouché needs holomorphy on the enclosed region and neighborhood.
topics.application: 稳定性零点计数、多项式根位置估计。
topics.applicationEn: Count stability-related zeros and estimate polynomial root locations.

topics.title: 误差、舍入与稳定性
topics.explain: 区分模型误差、截断误差和浮点舍入；稳定算法避免额外放大误差。
topics.explainEn: Distinguish model, truncation and rounding errors; stable algorithms avoid amplifying them unnecessarily.
topics.condition: 相对误差要求真值x≠0；接近零时应同时查看绝对误差。
topics.conditionEn: Relative error needs x≠0; near zero, also inspect absolute error.
topics.application: 数值结果验收；避免两个近等大数相减造成有效数字丢失。
topics.applicationEn: Validate numerical results and avoid cancellation of nearly equal large numbers.

topics.title: 二分法与牛顿法
topics.explain: 二分保持根的包围区间，牛顿利用局部切线加速。
topics.explainEn: Bisection maintains a root bracket; Newton uses tangents to accelerate locally.
topics.condition: 二分需连续且端点异号；牛顿需非零导数和合适初值，可能发散。
topics.conditionEn: Bisection requires continuity and opposite signs; Newton needs nonzero derivatives and suitable starts and may diverge.
topics.application: 非线性平衡、流量或经济临界点求解。
topics.applicationEn: Nonlinear equilibrium, flow and economic break-even roots.
steps: x₁=1.5，x₂≈1.416667；若导数为零应停止并更换方法。
stepsEn: For x²−2=0, start at x₀=1.
x₁=1.5 and x₂≈1.416667; stop or change method if the derivative is zero.

topics.title: 插值与样条
topics.explain: 插值通过数据点，样条用分段低次多项式减少高次插值振荡。
topics.explainEn: Interpolation passes through data points; splines reduce high-degree oscillations with low-degree pieces.
topics.formula: linear: y=y₀+(y₁−y₀)(x−x₀)/(x₁−x₀); cubic spline: piecewise degree 3, usually C²
topics.condition: 节点互异；外推误差可能很大，样条需边界条件。
topics.conditionEn: Distinct nodes; extrapolation can be unreliable and splines need boundary conditions.
topics.application: 标定曲线、测量数据重采样和路径平滑。
topics.applicationEn: Calibration curves, resampling and path smoothing.

topics.title: 数值积分
topics.explain: 用加权函数值近似定积分，精度取决于平滑性、步长与规则。
topics.explainEn: Weighted evaluations approximate integrals; accuracy depends on regularity, spacing and rule.
topics.formula: trapezoid: h[(f₀+fₙ)/2+Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ⁻¹fᵢ]; Simpson: (h/3)[f₀+fₙ+4Σodd fᵢ+2Σeven interior fᵢ]
topics.condition: 复合辛普森要求等距、偶数子区间；误差阶还需高阶导数有界。
topics.conditionEn: Composite Simpson needs equally spaced nodes and an even interval count; error orders need derivative bounds.
topics.application: 从离散流量计算总量、荷载积分。
topics.applicationEn: Integrate sampled flows and loads.
steps: 对x²在[0,2]积分，取两子区间、步长h=1。
辛普森值=(1/3)(0+4×1+4)=8/3，二次多项式在此被精确积分。
stepsEn: Integrate x² on [0,2] with two subintervals and h=1.
Simpson gives (1/3)(0+4×1+4)=8/3, exact for this quadratic.

topics.title: 数值微分方程
topics.explain: 按时间步推进状态，精度与稳定性必须同时考虑。
topics.explainEn: Advance states by time steps while checking both accuracy and stability.
topics.formula: Euler: yₙ₊₁=yₙ+h f(tₙ,yₙ); RK4 uses four staged slopes
topics.condition: 欧拉全局一阶、经典RK4全局四阶需适当光滑性；刚性问题常需隐式方法。
topics.conditionEn: Global orders one and four need smoothness; stiff problems often need implicit methods.
topics.application: 瞬态温度、设备动态；步长减半用于误差核查。
topics.applicationEn: Transient temperature and equipment dynamics; halve step sizes to check error.

topics.title: 线性系统分解与迭代
topics.explain: 用LU、QR或迭代方法避免显式求逆，大型稀疏系统可利用结构。
topics.explainEn: LU, QR and iterative methods avoid explicit inversion and exploit sparse structure.
topics.condition: LU通常需选主元；共轭梯度标准形式要求实对称正定矩阵。
topics.conditionEn: LU commonly needs pivoting; standard conjugate gradients require real symmetric positive definiteness.
topics.application: 有限元求解、测量平差；残差小不一定代表病态问题误差小。
topics.applicationEn: Finite elements and survey adjustment; a small residual may hide large error in an ill-conditioned problem.

topics.title: 有限差分与有限元
topics.explain: 差分离散导数，有限元以局部基函数逼近弱形式解。
topics.explainEn: Differences discretize derivatives; finite elements approximate weak solutions with local basis functions.
topics.condition: 误差依赖网格、正则性、边界条件和稳定性；有限元结果需网格收敛检查。
topics.conditionEn: Errors depend on mesh, regularity, boundaries and stability; check mesh convergence.
topics.application: 结构刚度、传热和渗流数值分析。
topics.applicationEn: Structural stiffness, heat transfer and seepage analysis.

topics.title: 傅里叶变换与FFT
topics.explain: 傅里叶变换描述频谱，FFT是快速计算离散变换的一类算法。
topics.explainEn: Fourier transforms describe spectra; FFT algorithms compute discrete transforms efficiently.
topics.condition: 频谱分析需注意采样率、混叠和窗函数；归一化约定需统一。
topics.conditionEn: Check sampling rate, aliasing, windows and normalization conventions.
topics.application: 振动频率识别、设备状态监测；采样频率需高于信号带宽两倍以满足理想采样条件。
topics.applicationEn: Identify vibration frequencies; ideal bandlimited reconstruction needs sampling above twice the bandwidth.

topics.title: 线性规划
topics.explain: 在线性约束下优化线性目标，可用单纯形或内点法。
topics.explainEn: Optimizes a linear objective under linear constraints with simplex or interior-point methods.
topics.formula: min cᵀx subject to Ax≤b, x≥0
topics.condition: 可行域可能空或目标无界；需核查可行性和单位。
topics.conditionEn: The feasible region may be empty or the objective unbounded; check feasibility and units.
topics.application: 资源配给、材料采购和运输成本优化。
topics.applicationEn: Resource allocation, purchasing and transport costs.

topics.title: 凸优化与全局最优
topics.explain: 凸目标与凸可行域使局部最优也是全局最优。
topics.explainEn: A convex objective over a convex feasible set makes every local optimum global.
topics.condition: 可行域须凸；严格凸函数在非空凸域上至多一个最小点，但不保证达到。
topics.conditionEn: The domain is convex; strict convexity gives at most one minimizer but not existence.
topics.application: 凸成本分配、可靠的参数拟合和能量最小化。
topics.applicationEn: Convex cost allocation, reliable fitting and energy minimization.

topics.title: 梯度下降与步长
topics.explain: 沿负梯度方向迭代减小目标，步长影响收敛和稳定性。
topics.explainEn: Iterates against the gradient; step size controls convergence and stability.
topics.condition: 固定步长常需L光滑等条件；非凸模型可能只到驻点。
topics.conditionEn: Fixed-step guarantees need conditions such as L-smoothness; nonconvex problems may reach only stationary points.
topics.application: 模型参数拟合；采用线搜索或步长试验防止震荡。
topics.applicationEn: Fit model parameters; line search or step-size checks prevent oscillation.
steps: 由x₀=2开始，x₁=1.2、x₂=0.72；过大步长可能发散。
stepsEn: For f(x)=x², the gradient is 2x; take α=0.2.
Starting at x₀=2 gives x₁=1.2 and x₂=0.72; excessive steps can diverge.

topics.title: KKT条件与对偶
topics.explain: 把目标、约束和乘子组合，互补松弛识别活跃约束。
topics.explainEn: Combines objectives, constraints and multipliers; complementary slackness identifies active constraints.
topics.condition: 必要性需约束资格条件；凸问题中可行KKT点为全局最优，强对偶常需Slater条件。
topics.conditionEn: Necessity needs a constraint qualification; feasible KKT points are globally optimal for convex problems, with strong duality often requiring Slater conditions.
topics.application: 容量约束的影子价格、最优资源分配。
topics.applicationEn: Capacity shadow prices and optimal resource allocation.

topics.title: 整数规划与分支定界
topics.explain: 离散决策用整数变量表示，分支定界结合松弛界与搜索。
topics.explainEn: Integer variables model discrete choices; branch-and-bound combines relaxations and search.
topics.formula: min cᵀx subject to Ax≤b, x∈Zⁿ
topics.condition: 把连续解四舍五入不保证可行或最优；大型实例可能计算昂贵。
topics.conditionEn: Rounding a continuous solution need not be feasible or optimal; large instances can be expensive.
topics.application: 人员排班、设备选型、采购批次数量。
topics.applicationEn: Staff rostering, equipment selection and purchasing batches.

topics.title: 动态规划与贝尔曼方程
topics.explain: 把决策分解为状态与阶段，用子问题最优值递推。
topics.explainEn: Splits decisions into states and stages and recursively uses optimal subproblem values.
topics.condition: 状态须保留未来决策所需信息；随机版本对下一状态价值取期望。
topics.conditionEn: The state retains relevant future information; stochastic versions use expected next-state value.
topics.application: 库存补货、多期预算及设备更新。
topics.applicationEn: Inventory replenishment, multistage budgets and equipment replacement.

topics.title: 排队论与利特尔定律
topics.explain: 稳态系统中平均在制数量等于到达率乘平均停留时间。
topics.explainEn: In a stable system, average population equals arrival rate times mean sojourn time.
topics.condition: 利特尔定律需长期稳定且统计口径一致；M/M/1另需泊松到达、指数服务和单服务台。
topics.conditionEn: Little’s law needs stable consistent long-run measures; M/M/1 additionally needs Poisson arrivals, exponential service and one server.
topics.application: 审批积压、卸料排队、工序等待；到达率逼近服务率时等待急增。
topics.applicationEn: Approval backlogs, unloading and process waits; delays surge near service capacity.

topics.title: 多目标与帕累托最优
topics.explain: 多个目标冲突时，帕累托解不存在同时全面改善的可行替代。
topics.explainEn: When goals conflict, a Pareto solution has no feasible alternative improving all objectives without worsening any.
topics.condition: 加权和不能保证找到非凸前沿上的所有帕累托点；目标量纲需处理。
topics.conditionEn: Weighted sums can miss nonconvex frontier points; handle differing units.
topics.application: 平衡工期、费用、安全与质量，展示取舍而非给出唯一绝对答案。
topics.applicationEn: Balance time, cost, safety and quality by showing trade-offs rather than one absolute answer.

title: 泛函分析与更高阶主题

topics.title: 赋范空间、巴拿赫与希尔伯特空间
topics.explain: 范数度量向量大小，巴拿赫空间在范数下完备，希尔伯特空间的范数来自内积。
topics.explainEn: Norms measure size; Banach spaces are complete and Hilbert norms arise from inner products.
topics.condition: 内积诱导范数，但不是每个范数都来自内积。
topics.conditionEn: An inner product induces a norm, but not every norm comes from an inner product.
topics.application: 函数空间、偏微分方程弱解和信号处理。
topics.applicationEn: Function spaces, weak PDE solutions and signal processing.

topics.title: 有界算子与对偶空间
topics.explain: 有界线性算子是连续线性映射，对偶空间收集连续线性泛函。
topics.explainEn: Bounded linear operators are continuous; the dual consists of continuous linear functionals.
topics.condition: 线性是有界等价连续的前提；无界算子需指定定义域。
topics.conditionEn: Linearity is essential to the bounded-continuous equivalence; unbounded operators need domains.
topics.application: 测量作为泛函、积分算子及无穷维模型。
topics.applicationEn: Measurements as functionals, integral operators and infinite-dimensional models.

topics.title: 正交投影与里斯表示
topics.explain: 希尔伯特空间中，闭凸集有唯一最近点；连续线性泛函可由内积表示。
topics.explainEn: In a Hilbert space, nonempty closed convex sets have unique nearest points; continuous linear functionals admit inner-product representations.
topics.formula: closed subspace M: x=P_Mx+(x−P_Mx), x−P_Mx⊥M; f(x)=⟨x,y⟩
topics.condition: 表示公式依赖内积线性侧约定；投影唯一性要求非空闭凸。
topics.conditionEn: Representation follows the chosen inner-product convention; nearest-point uniqueness needs nonempty closed convex sets.
topics.application: 无限维最小二乘、滤波与弱形式载荷表达。
topics.applicationEn: Infinite-dimensional least squares, filtering and weak-form loads.

topics.title: 弱收敛与紧算子
topics.explain: 弱收敛仅要求所有连续线性测量收敛；紧算子使有界序列像具有收敛子列。
topics.explainEn: Weak convergence tests continuous linear measurements; compact operators give convergent subsequences from bounded input sequences.
topics.condition: 范数收敛推出弱收敛，反向一般不成立；紧算子定义在赋范空间之间。
topics.conditionEn: Norm convergence implies weak convergence, not conversely; compact operators act between normed spaces.
topics.application: 偏微分方程存在性、积分方程与极限过程。
topics.applicationEn: PDE existence, integral equations and limiting arguments.

topics.title: 变分法与欧拉拉格朗日方程
topics.titleEn: Calculus of variations and Euler–Lagrange equations
topics.explain: 优化对象是整条函数或路径，而非有限个参数。
topics.explainEn: Optimizes an entire function or path rather than finitely many parameters.
topics.condition: 此必要条件假设足够光滑并固定端点；自由端点和约束需额外条件。
topics.conditionEn: This necessary condition assumes smoothness and fixed endpoints; free endpoints and constraints need additions.
topics.application: 最短路径、最小势能、弹性结构和最优控制。
topics.applicationEn: Shortest paths, minimum energy, elasticity and optimal control.

topics.title: 分布与弱导数
topics.explain: 通过对测试函数的作用扩展导数，使不光滑函数及集中源也可处理。
topics.explainEn: Generalizes derivatives through test-function actions to nonsmooth functions and concentrated sources.
topics.condition: 测试函数通常光滑且紧支撑；δ不是普通有限值函数。
topics.conditionEn: Test functions are typically smooth with compact support; δ is not an ordinary finite-valued function.
topics.application: 点荷载、冲击、有限元弱解与守恒律。
topics.applicationEn: Point loads, impulses, weak finite-element solutions and conservation laws.
